message.masked_invasion.warning: §cMasked Invasion! Wave %s starts in %s seconds with %s invaders. You will return to your respawn point when combat starts.
message.masked_invasion.begin: §cWave %s begins! Defend your base inside the %s-block arena. Defeat every invader to lift the boundary.
message.masked_invasion.boundary: §cDefend your base! You have been returned to the arena.
message.masked_invasion.victory: §aWave %s defeated! The boundary is lifted. The next invasion will be stronger.
message.masked_invasion.timeout: §4Time is up. Defense failed; Return by Death will activate.
message.masked_invasion.death: §4A defender died. Defense failed; Return by Death will activate.
message.masked_invasion.wait_holder: §cDefense failed. Waiting for a Return by Death holder to reconnect; logging out does not grant victory.
message.masked_invasion.missing_dimensio: §eInvasion waiting: respawn dimension is missing. An operator can cancel with /masked_invasion stop.
message.masked_invasion.no_landing: §eNo safe landing near the respawn point. Clear two blocks above a solid floor, or ask an operator to /masked_invasion stop.
message.masked_invasion.stopped: §eAn operator cancelled the invasion. The next one is scheduled after the configured interval.
message.masked_invasion.survival_require: Choose a player in Survival or Adventure mode.
message.masked_invasion.checkpoint_requi: An invasion requires a committed return checkpoint and a living, online Return by Death holder.
message.masked_invasion.already_active: This player already has an active invasion.
message.masked_invasion.nearby_active: Another base nearby is under attack. This invasion stays scheduled.
message.masked_invasion.status_idle: Completed %s waves; next invasion in about %s minutes of game time (sleep counts).
message.masked_invasion.reload_failed: Invalid form configuration; previous settings retained: %s
gamerule.miEnabled.description: Disabling cancels active invasions and schedules the next interval.
gamerule.miIntervalDays.description: Default 3 days. Advances with daytime while Survival/Adventure players are online; sleeping counts.
gamerule.miDefenseTicks.description: Default 18000 ticks (15 minutes); 0 disables the timeout. Remaining invaders at timeout cause failure.
gamerule.miArenaRadius.description: Centered on the respawn point locked at warning time; default 48 blocks.
gamerule.miArenaHeight.description: Default 24 blocks above and below the base to prevent vertical evasion.
gamerule.miRecallAtStart.description: Return defenders to their locked respawn points when combat starts.
gamerule.miConfinePlayers.description: Recall defenders leaving the arena and block dimension travel during combat.
gamerule.miHoldCheckpointDuringRaid: Masked Invasion: Defer checkpoints during invasions
gamerule.miHoldCheckpointDuringRaid.desc: Preserve the pre-invasion return point; normal automatic checkpoints resume after victory.
gamerule.miPlayerDeathFailsRaid: Masked Invasion: Defender death fails the raid
gamerule.miPlayerDeathFailsRaid.descript: Any defender death fails the encounter and triggers the shared world return.
gamerule.miFirstEnhancedMin: Masked Invasion: Minimum first-wave enhanced forms
gamerule.miFirstEnhancedMax: Masked Invasion: Maximum first-wave enhanced forms
gamerule.miFirstEnhancedMax.description: Default 2; values below the minimum use the minimum.
gamerule.miRaidersPerWave: Masked Invasion: Additional invaders per wave
gamerule.miRaidersPerWave.description: Default 2 additional invaders after each successful defense.
gamerule.miRaidersPerExtraPlayer: Masked Invasion: Additional invaders per extra defender
gamerule.miRaidersPerExtraPlayer.descrip: Default 2 per additional defender sharing the base.
gamerule.miMaxRaiders: Masked Invasion: Maximum invaders per encounter
gamerule.miMaxRaiders.description: Default 32; forms and attributes continue growing at this count limit.
gamerule.miBaseHealth.description: Default 40, multiplied by form and wave growth; Minecraft attribute limits apply.
gamerule.miBaseDamage.description: Default 3; native belt effects and weapon damage also apply.
gamerule.miHealthGrowthPercent: Masked Invasion: Health growth per wave (%)
gamerule.miHealthGrowthPercent.descripti: Default 15%, added linearly relative to wave 1.
gamerule.miDamageGrowthPercent: Masked Invasion: Attack growth per wave (%)
gamerule.miDamageGrowthPercent.descripti: Default 10%, added linearly relative to wave 1.
gamerule.miSpawnMinDistance.description: Default 6 blocks from respawn; searches closer safe positions if normal placement remains blocked.
gamerule.miSpawnMaxDistance.description: Default 20 blocks; uses loaded, safe ground inside the arena.
gamerule.miSpawnPerSecond.description: Default 4; bounded batches prevent a spawn spike.
gamerule.miRiderSkills: Masked Invasion: Invaders use Rider abilities
gamerule.miRiderSkills.description: Enable native KRC kick/punch abilities and Generic Henshin animations.
gamerule.miSkillIntervalTicks.descriptio: Default 200 ticks (10 seconds); native ability requirements still apply.
gamerule.miEquipmentDrops: Masked Invasion: Invaders drop Rider equipment
gamerule.miEquipmentDrops.description: Off by default; enables armor, belt and weapon drops.
gamerule.miVictoryEmeralds.description: Default 3 per defender; 0 disables rewards. Offline defenders receive them when they return.
gamerule.miBoundaryParticles: Masked Invasion: Show arena boundary particles
gamerule.miBoundaryParticles.description: Mark the boundary with sparse soul flame particles.
message.masked_invasion.invalid_respawn: §eThe original respawn point is invalid; the invasion will be rescheduled at a valid spawn.
